scripts.seed: docker compose exec rag-service python -m app.seed
scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/api run test && npm --workspace apps/frontend run test && PYTHONPATH=services/data-fetcher python3 -m unittest discover -s services/data-fetcher/tests
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/frontend run build && python3 -m compileall -q services/data-fetcher/data_fetcher
